scripts.bootstrap: uv sync --all-packages && pnpm install && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && pnpm reindex
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory services/commerce alembic upgrade head
scripts.contracts: uv run --directory services/commerce commerce-openapi && pnpm --filter @ai-commerce/contracts generate
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && pnpm --filter @ai-commerce/web lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run mypy services/commerce/src packages/telemetry/src && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm --filter @ai-commerce/web test
